segments.name: Bioprocessing
segments.description: Develops and commercializes bioprocessing technologies and systems that increase efficiency and flexibility in manufacturing biological drugs for biopharmaceutical companies and other life science customers.
segments.evidence: We currently operate as one bioprocessing business, with a comprehensive suite of products to serve both upstream and downstream processes in biological drug manufacturing.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue primarily from sales of consumable and single-use bioprocessing products, plus growing hardware and equipment offerings, to global biopharmaceutical companies, contract development and manufacturing organizations and other life science companies.
revenueModel.evidence: The majority of our revenue is derived from consumable and/or single-campaign ("single-use") product sales, though we have grown our hardware and equipment offerings in recent years.
